Home / Solicitations / SOL-2026-047

Fleet tire supply and mounting services

SOL-2026-047 · Invitation to bid · Fleet Services

Summary

Closing dateSep 11, 2026, 2 p.m. Central
Issuing departmentFleet Services
ContactDana Wexley, contract officer, bids@lakefront-vn.example
ResponsesRegistered partners only, through the partner console

Scope of work

Supply, mounting and balancing of tires for 146 city vehicles, from sedans to refuse trucks, at the Fleet Services garage or at a vendor facility within ten miles of City Hall. Includes retreading of heavy-truck casings.

  • Unit-price contract, two years.
  • Emergency call-out within four hours, 24 hours a day.
  • Pricing held for the full term; adjustments only through the published index clause.

Addenda

  • Addendum 1 (Aug 4, 2026): vehicle list corrected to 146 units.

Questions about this solicitation go to the contact above in writing, no later than seven days before the closing date. Answers are published here as addenda.
